narrative:
## Handover Summary — Sales & Margin Forecast

Margin curves are approved for all retail categories and reconcile to the PMIS baseline.

## Key Decisions
• Fresh & Chilled margin raised on waste reduction evidence
• Electricals England margin lowered for price-match and promotional exposure
• Waitrose.com margin raised on basket size and substitution improvements

## Recommendation for Operating Cost Phase
Hold the cost plan to the 2% growth cap so margin gains reach operating profit. Partner pay and technology dual-running are the two lines to watch.
